Name: Seasonal Retexture of Gabriel in Nyapu's style
Author: PureJJoy
Description:
Hello! I drew most of this (Kudos to Nyapu for their work). 

[b]Instructions[/b]
1. Unzip the file
2. Copy the images in said file
3. Go to "Mods\[CP] CakeyBunz  Gabriel Retexture\assets\Portraits" and paste the images
4. Press replace files and you're done!

That all, Enjoy!
